Rugged handheld / 6.8″ / Android 14

Tuga A6

The one that lives in your pocket.

£299 Includes VAT. Free UK delivery

The A6 is the smallest device in the range and the one most people start with. It goes in a pocket or a belt holster, survives being dropped down a stairwell, and still has charge at the end of a long shift. The 64MP night vision camera earns its keep in loft spaces, voids and under floors where a torch and a phone in the same hand is one hand too few. 5G means photos and job sheets upload before you have got back to the van.
